body:
Repeated row churn retained obsolete leaf packs, immutable manifest revisions and successful native appender creation history, while deletion retries could outlive manager shutdown. This repairs ownership through the existing manager, recovery roots and GC, and adds the supported lifecycle and mutation-cost harnesses needed to qualify R1.

Implements #5066 and incorporates the reviewed nine-file mutation harness from #5072 under parent #5056, on main `76498575`. #5059 mutation-cost acceptance and #5060/#5061 retained evidence remain open after this code lands.

- Cancel and join admitted deletion retries before manager files close; concurrent Close shares completion and errors.
- Protect current, both selectable fallback roots, prepared publication and held readers while reclaiming obsolete immutable revisions through exact namespace leases and durable quarantine. Revalidate inventory and fresh protection before every batch. GC owns at most 18 child descriptors: 16 selected deletion handles, one scan child or quarantine placeholder, and one temporary link-validation handle.
- Keep the exact quarantine placeholder open until deletion returns; validate its link before cleanup and before rename overwrites the destination. Failed cleanup joins causes, preserves canonical/rebound evidence and poisons maintenance with ErrRecoveryRequired. Successful cleanup preserves the original error and permits retry.
- Select each rebuilt current leaf pack's exact physical closure while protected roots retain theirs. Retire successful native registration history only for the exact manager-owned file; ambiguous, failed, unrelated and standalone rewrite records stay protected.
- Qualify the supported command-WAL lifecycle fixture, persisted options, full-root census and maintenance boundaries. Capability guards refuse unsupported promotion fixtures before construction.
- Add a generic row-replacement cost sweep: two payload widths 96/4096, request batches 1/32, indexed/unindexed collections and bio/email-city changes. Retained mode uses 4096 rows, 100 requests and five fresh-DB repetitions across 16 cells. Report acknowledgement latency separately from Flush latency and physical sync/WAL counters. Independent validation requires externally frozen source and six exact provenance pins; producer validation remains UNQUALIFIED.

Revision GC completes eligible batches in one explicit call and preserves deletion counts on later failure. Writer and snapshot-admission locks span the call; repeated scans cost O(N²/16). Per-phase footprint admission is not a cumulative I/O or pause quota. No production rotation cap, WAL mode, automatic maintenance policy or on-disk format changes. The persistent value/leaf logs remain storage, separate from redo WAL.

Validation uses Linux185/111, Go1.26.4, GOWORK=off and matching isolated caches:

- Current runtime `cb5b0d7b` at source `8506a498` passes 114 focused test rows normally in 74.603s and under race in 126.954s, plus vet. All runtime and covered R1 test blobs apply unchanged to candidate `45d2cf68`; the separate COW lifetime fixture repair is verified below. Coverage includes R1 mutation 18 process-exit cuts, lifecycle maintenance three process-exit cuts, current/held/prepared/both recovery roots, revision namespace protection, RLIMIT64 with257 revisions, exact quarantine cleanup and manager retry shutdown.
- Exact `ebe414b6` passes 51 additive test rows normally in 42.459s and under race in 53.255s, plus vet. These cover the reviewed C smoke/corruption harness and current-main shared writer-observer, rewrite-winning-revision, held physical pointer/reopen and accepted command-WAL wait-failure paths.
- Independent reviews at exact `ebe414b6` find no material integration defect in the 56 changed upstream production inputs or the incorporated C harness. All 1,122 runtime inputs are frozen; C code/test/capture blobs match reviewed `90fa3dc6`. Fresh runtime performance is required rather than inferred from unchanged workload source. Main `76498575` adds only eight external benchmark-accounting document/harness paths; final `45d2cf68` retains exact runtime and A/C harness bindings.
- Canonical CI inventory remains 14 workflows / 56 members. All 58 Python contract tests pass at `8506`; the 36 affected inventory/impact tests also pass at `ebe414`, `a64560e8` `aa8614ea`, `0245d8e0` and `e4e7a303`. Unchanged contract/headroom checks retain their original source binding.
- Final `a64560e8` isolates the COW maintenance lifetime fixture from periodic value-log maintenance using construction-time `ValueLogGenerationOff`, preserving the original three lanes with `JournalLanes:3`. Its explicit capture/install, pressure, old-view and retry assertions remain intact. The whole fixture passes normally (7 test rows, 0.930s) and under race (7 rows, 1.140s), with caching vet and formatting checks. Original `ebe414` Windows denial-assertion FAIL, matching-main PASS and an exact-head Linux PASS remain retained; the original Windows worker schedule was not traced. The exact repaired-head Windows lifetime job passes all five rows; its original failure remains preserved.
- Final `aa8614ea` repairs the unchanged main COW power-loss fixture's error classification. Each actual meta-write/post-write cut (`AfterMetaWrite`, `BeforeMetaSync`, `AfterMetaSync`) can poison the asynchronous publisher before the checkpoint gate returns, so the fixture accepts `ErrRecoveryRequired` only for those three cuts with captured `ResourceMeta`. All other cuts still require the injected cause, and all stable-image/group/durable-ACK/NoWAL recovery assertions remain. The whole 36-cut fixture passes 37 test rows normally in 10.635s and under race in 36.110s, plus root TreeDB vet and formatting. Original `a64560e8` Windows before-meta-sync FAIL and matching-main PASS remain retained; the precise Windows goroutine schedule was not traced. Independent source review is CLEAN; required final-head Windows and all other CI still must pass.
- Final `0245d8e0` adds a checked checkpoint before the native ordered-root value-log GC fixture captures reachability. Unsynced ordered-root publication admits work before the coordinator durable frontier finishes advancing; the fixture can otherwise exhaust its eight capture attempts during that transition. All native-route, raw-pointer, GC referenced-segment, value and later checkpoint/reopen assertions remain. The separate pending-publisher/older-durable-root GC test remains intact. Original `aa8614ea` Windows root-capture FAIL is retained; its actual rejection predicate and schedule were not traced. Independent review is CLEAN; both focused cases pass normally (0.496s) and under race (1.586s), with DB vet and formatting; the 36 affected inventory/impact tests pass, The exact `0245d8e0` Windows root-capture case passes (0.22s); required successor CI must still pass. No production capture relaxation or stale-error waiver.
- Final `e4e7a303` waits under the existing bounded test context for every voter to report the actual prepared/runtime/ACTIVE predicate after snapshot-tail recovery. The DATA applied retry prefix and durable completions do not establish replay of the independent CATALOG lifecycle record. All subsequent current-DB/catalog, strict search, retry, canonical row/result and stale-binding assertions remain intact. Original `0245d8e0` Linux race owner-2 activation FAIL and main same-case PASS are preserved; its precise false predicate component remains untraced. Independent review is CLEAN. Seven shared-fixture variants pass 21 test rows normally in 36.901s and under race in 39.487s, plus nativewire vet and formatting; the 36 inventory/impact tests pass. No production or timeout change. Required final-head CI must pass.
- Final `45d2cf68` requires actual `Status.VectorPhase == "active"` in the existing RF4 intermediate voter-rejoin wait alongside the applied DATA prefix. Retiring and reopening the real DATA leader also restarts its independent CATALOG voter; DATA catchup alone cannot authorize its actual vector backend. The prior final snapshot-tail wait remains. All existing error/group/prefix checks, contexts, polling and later retry/current-row/document/lifecycle oracles remain. Original `e4e7a303` Sparse qualification refusal (catalog-meta-unavailable) is preserved: the same command produced one parent FAIL and two later PASS observations, which do not waive that failure; the exact failed catalog state was unlogged. Source review is CLEAN. The corrected whole RF4 test passes three normal repetitions (9 test rows, 10.629s), one race repetition (3 rows, 5.656s), nativewire vet and formatting on Linux111 with unchanged runtime/A-C harness bindings. Canonical inventory is byte-identical. Fresh exact-head Sparse and full TreeDB CI must pass.
- Original focused cleanup `52bc2147`, broader bounded-GC, pack/current/fallback, native creation-history RED/GREEN, packet guards and supported rehearsals remain retained under their actual source identities. The initial sparse-checkout missing-module refusal, broad collections timeout and isolated passing vector test remain preserved.

The public 32-revision smoke is correctness/cost smoke only. Final landed-source A/C/D will measure reads, mutation cost, repeated maintenance, physical component growth and sampled memory. Logical census is not allocated blocks; sampled heap is not RSS or an exact peak. Finite active/latest-per-lane retention and bounded descriptors do not establish unlimited capacity or latency bounds. The mutation sweep does not claim native partial-setter, metadata-reference update cost, larger-population or concurrent throughput.

Auxiliary M0 timing at original `3182` remains FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE: all 20 samples passed correctness; one unchanged matched main/control experiment also failed the unchanged noise rule with all 40 correctness samples passing. [Original disposition and evidence](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/pull/5071#issuecomment-6015235219) remain preserved. The user explicitly approved the auxiliary M0 red/inconclusive merge exception on 2026-10-06. This waives only that timing signal; required current-head CI, code/review gates and fresh A/C/D outcome acceptance still apply. The later `ebe414`, `a64560e8`, `aa8614ea` and `0245d8e0` M0 runs pass under the same original rule and are retained separately. No threshold, sample count, outlier or original result changed.

Refs #5066, #5059, #5060, #5061, #5056. Does not close retained qualification or parent gates. External rewrite owner #5037 retains its scope.
